Jev vs LLM: the real difference ⚡

An LLM answers one word at a time. Jev answers everything at once.
💬 LLM: "Definitely urgent! This ticket describes..." → text you have to parse
✅ Jev: you define the questions + allowed answers up front (choice, score, yes/no) → typed answers + calibrated probability, in one parallel pass

TypeSafe says 40-200x faster and much cheaper than frontier models. That's the company's claim; independent tests are still thin.

Part 2 of 4. Next: can Jev hallucinate?
Follow for the series.

yt_description:
Jev vs LLM: an LLM generates text token by token; TypeSafe's Jev fills a schema of typed answers (choice, score, yes/no) in one parallel pass, each with a calibrated probability. Output tokens are not billed.

Speed and cost figures (40-200x faster, much cheaper) are TypeSafe's own claims, not independently verified yet. Example values on screen are illustrative.
